level1_releases.name: openclaw 2026.11.1
level1_releases.body_excerpt:
## 2026.11.1

### Highlights

- Safer Mac settings: failed config saves no longer overwrite secrets, and turning off Tailscale exposure keeps Gateway authentication intact. (#187734, #187664) Fixes #187600, #187597 Thanks @anmol0b.
- More reliable channel replies: Telegram, Discord, and webhook conversations keep reaching the agent after request handlers or earlier turns finish. (#179200, #179385, #179704, #189457) Fixes #178554 Thanks @steipete, @LiuwqGit, @jalehman, and @vincentkoc.
- Conversations survive more interruptions: oversized turns retain useful history, and stopping the first Claude CLI turn no longer starts the next message from scratch. (#191146, #181966, #186380) Fixes #191133, #181945 Thanks @Yun-0000, @obviyus, @mirasrael, and @holgergruenhagen.
- Update recovery gets unstuck after crashed or canceled updaters, restores the Windows Gateway after failed verification, and avoids repeated full-database copying during large-state checks. (#177932, #186787, #189647, #182632, #187921) Fixes #177684, #184893, #189620 Thanks @duyufansh2008, @RomneyDa, @fuller-stack-dev, @TheAngryPit, @sukhdeepjohar, @steipete, @syxscott, and @stephen3303.
- Subagents keep their follow-ups through model and session changes, while parent sessions receive child approvals even with a custom session store. (#186238, #183501, #189827) Fixes #179289, #189823 Thanks @steipete, @Marvinthebored, @RomneyDa, and @ekinnee.
- Android End Talk with a compatible Gateway stops listening without canceling accepted agent work, so its answer can still arrive in chat; explicit cancellation remains available. (#172276, #188798) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Provider recovery respects provider-specified rate-limit timing, and Gemini Flash text models use Interactions by default on the official API-key endpoint while custom proxies retain their existing default. (#180280, #189395) Thanks Ayaan Zaidi, @evomach, @sukhdeepjohar, @RomneyDa.

### Changes

- Claude CLI: saved subscription accounts can make configured models available without a separate native login, and operators can opt into native Agent and Workflow orchestration through `plugins.entries.anthropic.config.managedNativeTools`; the default remains off and restricted runs keep their existing tool limits. (#179203, #183765) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Anthropic: API-key setup can record an optional Anthropic workspace ID; existing workspace headers are preserved, and workspace-scoped keys need no extra setting. (#186976) Thanks Ayaan Zaidi, @evom

level1_releases.name: v2.1.318
level1_releases.body_excerpt:
## What's changed

- Added a record of your answer when Claude Code asks to turn on the mods it writes in a session
- Added `assume_role` on `mantle` upstreams of the Claude apps gateway, for a role in another AWS account and for per-developer AWS cost attribution
- Added an `effort` option to a mod's `$.model.fork`, so a quick side job can run at `low` whatever effort the session uses; the result reports the effort sent
- Added the date a stored claude.ai sign-in ends to `claude auth status` (`loginExpiresAt`) and to `claude -p` JSON results (`credential_expires_at`)
- Added a one-line stderr warning to `claude -p` text output, starting 10 days before a stored claude.ai sign-in ends
- Fixed `--continue` sometimes losing the earlier conversation after a malformed tool call's retries ran out (regression in 2.1.314)
- Fixed macOS sessions with many running Bash commands stalling while memory grew
- Fixed permission prompts being answered by keys typed just after sending a message, or before a slow prompt appeared
- Fixed `/logout`, `claude auth logout` and `claude mcp remove` reporting success, and changes to trust, consent or MCP settings being dropped with no word, when the config file could not be updated on a shared network home directory
- Fixed jobs exiting with `Not logged in` when another terminal or host signs in again to the same account and organization on the same home
- Fixed `claude mcp add` and `remove` writing the config without its lock: they now wait for it or exit 1, though another job's save can still replace a saved server
- Fixed `claude plugin` commands exiting before a slow token refresh was saved, which could sign you out on the next run
- Fixed `claude plugin validate` passing a custom-named marketplace file that `claude plugin marketplace add` rejects
- Fixed stdio MCP servers that exit on the version probe being re-probed on every start; a server that dies in under 3s for its own reason is also pinned to the legacy handshake for 7 days
- Fixed sessions being refused at startup by an `allowedProviders` list that another login on the same machine had stored
- Fixed idle compaction replacing a conversation with a reply that was not a summary
- Fixed the "Now using usage credits" notice reappearing about every 30 seconds while a background subagent is running
- Fixed custom slash commands that fail, or that only Claude can invoke, printing nothing in `claude -p` and SDK sessions
- Fixed `claude -p` and Agent SDK sessions reporting suc
